timeDefinitions.trackStartTime: first point of the ADS-B track (UTC); not necessarily the take-off time
timeDefinitions.trackEndTime: last point of the ADS-B track (UTC); not necessarily the landing time
timeDefinitions.referenceTime: trackStartTime, else trackEndTime (the definition used by the monthly data)

timeBasis.TRACK_END_FALLBACK: track start missing; referenceTime is the track end

timeDefinitions.windowMembership: a flight belongs to [start, end) when start <= referenceTime < end (UTC)
timeDefinitions.dayFiles: a day file holds the flights whose referenceTime falls on that UTC date (minute resolution; track times in full precision are in the research data)
timeDefinitions.notMixed: flights possibly airborne during a window (track start/end overlapping it) are a different selection and are not used

implied_speed.note: airport-to-airport distance / track duration; the track may start after take-off, so high values point to track or time problems, not to fast aircraft

thresholds.note: Phase 6B detection; detection only, nothing corrected

knownGap.evidence: worldwide flights <= 5% of the same weekday-hour baseline (Phase 6B); 6 flights against about 271,700 expected
knownGap.interpretation: data-collection gap (inferred, not confirmed by the data provider); not a reduction of air traffic
